about: Assertions that fail on this branch for a reason that is NOT the change you are testing. run-checks.mjs marks a failure KNOWN when EVERY failing item of that check matches one of these patterns (a regex tested against the failing line's text); anything else is NEW. `flaky: true` = it fails on some runs only (a timing budget on a loaded box) — accepted when it fails, never reported FIXED? when it passes. v150 B took the 2026-09-24 baseline (46 entries, main at ca9db0a) down to these: every other entry was a stale or under-sampled CHECK and was fixed in the check (docs/CHECKS.md, 'The baseline'), and the v110 credit fall-through was closed in the engine. What is left is the GAME being wrong in a place this pass did not own (the declare screens — another worker's; the vault; the renderer's jersey numbers) or an assertion that is a wall-clock frame rate by nature. Delete an entry when you fix it; see docs/CHECKS.md.

failures.pattern: ^the season-result declare card states the one-shot stakes
failures.note: GAME (AUDIT §2.1): the only on-screen 'One shot' is inside a hidden report-card tab (.hubv75-sec display:none) and the result dock carries no stakes line — fixed by the v150 A worker with the declare warning

failures.pattern: ^the epitaph fits inside v75's scroll budget on a phone
failures.note: GAME (AUDIT §2.6): 2.15 screens — declineResult has no v75 sectioner config since v146 E made #screen the one panel; the v150 A worker owns the career-end tabs

failures.pattern: ^(the vault holds a usable frame rate under a 16x pour|and then it goes to sleep, so a settled hoard costs nothing|RESTOCK puts the shed coins back in their columns)
failures.note: a frames-per-second floor and a settle timer measured in wall time on a CPU-contended headless box; one run each in the baseline

failures.pattern: ^every pose that can show a number carries a band read off the art
failures.note: GAME (renderer): v109 B's catch sequence (`spr_<kit>_<dir>_catchseq<v>_<f>`) is registered after the v104 band scan and never gets a band, yet placeMarker NUMBERS it — its `detailedAction` regex /^(juke|stiff|hurdle|catch\d|divecatch|pancake|getup)/ does not match 'catchseq'. Either read the band for the catchseq cells when they are registered, or add catchseq to detailedAction (hide the number through the reach, as for catch\d)

one spawn in the baseline read kit-mask alpha 19 (> MASK_MAX 8): the crowd polygon touches the feathered edge of the v106 kit mask, so a rare flash lands on the soft edge of the man. Not reproduced in v150 B's runs; GAME if it recurs (the spawn should reject mask alpha > 8, as the check does)

failures.pattern: ^every byte of the sheet had landed
failures.note: a race between the network and the v94 script's first run (the warm's last byte vs the engine tick), not a budget the load scale can stretch; on a loaded box the script can run before the transfer ends. The v112 A requests themselves (two, adopted) are asserted separately

failures.pattern: ^(a SECOND loading scene mounted in the same session|it found the sheet already decoded in memory|it added ZERO network requests for the sheet|it had a picture up with nothing left to load|and that picture is the film loader)
failures.note: door two (the live game's loader) only exists while the Phaser bundle compiles and the scene stands, under a 9s watchdog measured from its own mount (03-splash.js). At a 1-minute load of 30+ on 4 cores the compile holds the main thread past that ceiling (a v150 B probe: mounted, main thread blocked ~7s, closed by the watchdog at 9s, never READY), so the door is gone before the check can read it. Passes on a quiet box; the waits are game-state and load-scaled since v150 B
